_comment: `klt erc` supply spec for the routed SAR_CTRL digital macro -- the
structural power-delivery read T1 item 11 grades for the DIGITAL
partition (klayout-tools#2025, issue #559). Sibling of
adc_block.supply-spec.json, which covers the analog partition only.
klt erc layout/adc-top/sar_ctrl/sar_ctrl.gds \
layout/erc/sar_ctrl.supply-spec.json --format json
Item 11 is the STRUCTURAL question: is each supply one electrical
island, and is every n-well tied to VDD. The pass conditions are zero
`erc.unconnected_net` / `erc.supply_short` naming VDD or VSS and zero
`erc.missing_tie`, not the report's top-level `status`. IR drop and
electromigration (`klt power`) are outside it.
LAYER NUMBERS are the gf180mcuD layer table's (gf180mcu.lyp), the same
pairs adc_block.supply-spec.json uses: Poly2 30/0, COMP 22/0, Nplus
32/0, Nwell 21/0, Contact 33/0, Metal1 34/0, Via1 35/0, Metal2 36/0,
Via2 38/0, Via3 40/0, Metal3 42/0, Metal4 46/0, Via4 41/0, Metal5
81/0. Each is drawn in sar_ctrl.gds (`klt layers`).
STACKUP covers every strap layer the P&R response lists in
`power.straps[]` -- Metal1 and Metal4 (the Metal4 straps are #519's) --
plus the Metal2/Metal3 the PDN stripes and vias cross
(`power.placed.special_nets[].stripe_layers`). `label_layer` is
declared on Metal1 (34/10) and Metal4 (46/10), the two layers that
carry the VDD/VSS pin text of this macro.
NETS are upper-case `VDD` / `VSS` because that is the label text in
the routed GDS and the P&R response's power_net / ground_net; `klt erc`
matches by exact string equality. Both are `kind: supply`.
TIES: the filltie tap cells (power.tapcell_master) put an Nplus-marked
COMP strip in each n-well; `tap_requires: ["32/0"]` narrows the tap
region to those strips, as in the analog spec.
No `devices[]`: the macro is standard cells only, with no drawn
resistor or MiM bodies.
